meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 Microsoft Graph 创建和管理 AI 代理身份:新建“代理身份蓝图”与“蓝图主体”,为每个代理实例建独立身份,并配置 OAuth2 令牌交换(fmi_path、OBO、跨租户)及权限。
howto.when: 当用户提到“代理身份蓝图”“蓝图主体”“代理 OAuth/fmi_path 令牌交换”等,或要求为 AI 代理创建独立身份时触发;不用于常规 Entra 应用注册和 Foundry 代理创作。

say.text: 创建一个代理身份蓝图,并创建对应的蓝图主体。
say.note: 会依次调用两个 Graph 接口。

say.text: 为 agent-1 创建代理身份并授予 User.Read.All 权限。
say.note: 会创建该身份并添加 appRoleAssignment。

say.text: 用 fmi_path 为代理生成 OBO 运行时令牌。
say.note: 执行两步骤令牌交换;需先在蓝图配置凭据。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses Microsoft Graph to create Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities, and to configure OAuth2 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) and permission grants.
howto.when_en: Triggered by mentions of Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth/fmi_path exchange, or per-agent identities. Not for standard Entra app registration or Foundry agent authoring.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity Blueprint and its corresponding BlueprintPrincipal.
say_en.note: Calls the Graph Blueprint and BlueprintPrincipal endpoints.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity for agent-1 and grant User.Read.All app permission.
say_en.note: Creates the Agent Identity and adds an appRoleAssignment.

say_en.text: Use fmi_path to get an OBO runtime token for the agent.
